answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake bonded to its identity before it can transact. Spinning up a thousand fake agents then means a thousand real deposits, turning a cheap sybil flood into an expensive voyage no attacker wants to fund. Honest agents climb a trellis of attested interactions to earn reputation, while the forfeitable bond acts like a reef that wrecks hollow throwaway identities trying to slip into the economy.
